positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description: Building out Conversational AI experiences and simplifying the creation of LLM apps for users

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Creating experiences to allow people to converse with conversational AIs using telephony services such as Twilio 
•	Wrote and performed load tests to stress, identify, and fix weaknesses which lead to scaling from only ten concurrent users to thousands
•	Refactored our media streaming service and conversation protocol to make them scalable and more resilient
•	Prototyped and built the initial UI and backend services for Reality Defender, a website used to detect deepfakes

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: •	Built new online credit card application experiences using React and Redux where customers could prefill their application through various channels

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Maintained Capital One's retail partner credit card application while migrating existing features to a more modern credit card application experience
•	Designed and implemented ETL pipelines in AWS to migrate third party vendor files into Capital One environment while properly handling sensitive data 
•	Established CICD pipelines to deploy infrastructure and code to various AWS services for ETL transmission using Terraform

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Member of the Partnership Originations team which creates and manages applications for partnership cards
•	Created end to end tests using Cucumber and Ruby for GM’s customer portal which allows customers to look up their card information online
•	Developed a proof of concept for allowing the card application to be directly integrated in retail partner websites

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Member of the BXP Cloud Lifecycle Management team that aimed to develop and automate features on the cloud
•	Collaborated with employees in different locations in development of a website to automate and display cloud service offerings
•	Assisted in the creation of an API using the RESTful API to allow business units to check whether a cloud server is shutdown on the weekend

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
•	Tutor students individually and help them master concepts learned and understand programming assignments
•	Grade homework and tests, and return proper feedback to students with errors in assignments
